description: SvDockManager as an analytics workspace in Svelte 5. Panels carry a per-pane minSize so a splitter cannot crush them below a usable width, and the whole layout, tiled, floating and auto-hidden, serializes to JSON: Save and Load persist it to localStorage so a user's arrangement survives a reload.

faq.question: How is the layout saved?
faq.answer: JSON.stringify(workspace) is written to localStorage on Save and parsed back into bind:workspace on Load; the manager rebuilds every pane, window and hidden panel from it.

faq.question: What does minSize enforce?
faq.answer: A minimum width or height in pixels for each pane; splitters stop at it, and a window resize that would violate it re-balances the neighbouring panes instead.

faq.question: Can panels hold live components?
faq.answer: Yes. Each panel renders a snippet or component, here charts and grids, and stays mounted while tiled; keepAlive keeps inactive tabs mounted too.
